notes: 0.3.19: Create a card the catalog doesn't have, straight from Add Card with a photo; it goes to review and works for you right away. Your price and the Benchmark price are two separate things now: Benchmark is never editable, Your price is yours, and Accept lines them up. Edit cost and your price right in the Inventory and pricing tables. A card you add gets a real Benchmark scan on its own. Graded cards no longer get a Benchmark worked out from ungraded sales. Challenge a Benchmark you disagree with and it comes to us for review. Buyouts save to your account, several at once, with a table to pick up where you left off, delete with confirm, and an Accept that can never strand a lot again. Live Claims delete works. Expenses log in a side panel. Shipping runs on your own Shippo account, connected in Settings with a four-step walkthrough, and nobody's labels bill anyone else. The card panel shows your own photo and takes a paste anywhere. Inventory gets an Added column and headers that line up. The Feedback button captures the screen again. The pricing page has margins and a scan box that stays put. Deleting a trade clears it off the screen. The card panel shows the Benchmark on its own at the top and your price beside Current; typing a price never touches the Benchmark, and Accept lines the two up. A buyout row shows the Benchmark and your own price side by side: the Benchmark is the app's suggestion and can't be typed over, and everything the offer touches follows your price whenever you set one.
